hypotheses.explanation: The intended panel-hiding operation affects only StudyPanel, an EMPTY. Blender mesh descendants retain their own render visibility, explaining the unwanted orange panel and the reported parent/mesh visibility mismatch.

camera_calibration.reason: set_view directly assigns the requested sensor width of 40.8; only numerical tolerance is expected.

geometry_replay.reason: Emission multiplies geometry_frame by the primitive world matrix, retaining primitive dimensions and nonuniform frame scale; no conflicting scale operation is shown.

position_replay.reason: The same matrix product retains primitive origin, and the supplied furniture hierarchy supports the final group move.

visibility_isolation.reason: The single panel mesh should remain visible after both group toggles: visible fraction after False approximately 1, hidden fraction after True approximately 0.

support_relation.reason: For StudyDesk supported on Floor.001, the function translates by the computed world AABB gap. Small residual uncertainty concerns evaluation timing and approximate bounds.

dependency_move.reason: All five desk meshes have the expected named part parents under StudyDesk, so movement should propagate without contract violations.

material_dependency.reason: Zero non-target changes is strongly expected: mesh data and materials are copied, and the supplied Top.001 edit already passed. The interval conservatively allows one unexpected ownership-related change.

hypotheses.explanation: A weaker alternative is that the panel should have been excluded during compilation, but emit unconditionally realizes every solid and member. This requires an unprovided plan-level exclusion contract. The independently visible group-toggle defect would still exist under this explanation.

camera_calibration.reason: An unwanted emitted panel does not change the direct sensor assignment.

geometry_replay.reason: An extra correctly dimensioned mesh need not produce a basis-length discrepancy; this scalar does not directly test intended inclusion.

position_replay.reason: Unwanted inclusion can coexist with correct translations relative to the current public plan.

visibility_isolation.reason: The supplied visibility implementation still leaves the existing panel mesh visible through both group toggles. This prediction is identical to H1 and cannot distinguish them.

support_relation.reason: The separate panel is outside StudyDesk, so its inclusion should not affect desk support on Floor.001.

dependency_move.reason: The desk's documented part hierarchy remains correct regardless of whether the separate panel should exist.

material_dependency.reason: The copying implementation and existing successful edit favor zero collateral changes, with the same ownership uncertainty as H1.

raw_evidence.source_scope: Actual SceneAct Blender compiler plus visibility/support/edit interfaces; controlled scene-description-to-Blender program repair, not natural-image end-to-end H

non_target.comparison: Exact direct comparison of matrices, local vertices, material values/nodes and parent; no hashes

raw_evidence.requirements: Compile a reusable SceneAct scene plan, retain intended world transforms and visibility, support composite furniture, preserve dependencies under group movement and local edits. Use images as desired appearance; investigate any shared module.

plan.reason: Structured evidence only; no active experimentation. Actual lower tool cost recorded.
